An “Elevated” or “Reduced” label is the vendor’s classification relative to that export’s comparison range, not proof of disease, causation, abnormal protein function, or statistical significance after multiple-testing correction. Different comparator ranges can assign different labels to the identical expression value. Gene expression measured in blood does not establish the corresponding state in the brain or other organs. Individual values and exploratory networks should be interpreted cautiously alongside cell composition and assay methods.

Amatica 31-marker protein panel · Blood draw milestone

Outside both ranges: 52 genes are flagged by both reference systems (all in the same direction in the supplied dataset). This is a stronger cross-reference signal, not an independent replication or proof of clinical significance.

Curated panels are biological groupings, not additional measurements. Each gene appears once, grouped by its first panel alphabetically (or the selected panel). Additional memberships are noted only when applicable. A single curated comparator is shown for each gene.
